title: Locking Down the Finetuned LLMs Safety

contributions.purpose: 解决现有安全对齐无法抵御微调阶段安全风险的问题——仅 10 条 toxic 句子即可让模型服从有害指令
contributions.mechanism: 提出 SafetyLock：用 safety probes 定位与有害性最相关的注意力头并为每个头确定一个 safety direction，推理时对这些头注入干预向量把内部激活推向 harmlessness；跨多 token 维度搜索激活方向以增强鲁棒/可迁移性
contributions.evaluation: 把有害指令响应率从 60% 降到 <1%；ASR 从 54.24% 降到 0.03%；DeepInception 攻击 ASR 从 98% 降到 2%；再对齐 <0.01 秒、无额外 GPU 内存
contributions.domain: 大语言模型微调安全 / 对齐
contributions.source_quote: We introduce SafetyLock, a novel alignment intervention method that maintains robust safety post-fine-tuning through efficient and transferable mechanisms.

contributions.purpose: 让安全干预可从基座模型一次性提取、批量分发到多个微调变体，避免重复搜索安全模式
contributions.mechanism: 基于'微调模型与原模型保留相似 safety-related 激活表示'的发现，从原模型（如 Llama-3-Instruct）提取一组 safety bias directions（Meta-SafetyLock），普适地应用到各微调模型
contributions.evaluation: 在 Llama-3-8B/70B Instruct、Mistral-Large-2 123B 上高效迁移；无需 GPU、<0.01 秒部署；八项通用任务上响应率仅从 99.4% 轻降到 98.1%
contributions.source_quote: our approach uniquely operates at the attention-head level, supported by our discovery that safety-relevant attention heads maintain consistency even after fine-tuning. This insight enables us to extract a single Meta-SafetyLock from the base model that can be rapidly deployed across multiple fine-tuned variants

contributions.purpose: 验证 SafetyLock 在不同风险等级、攻击类型、模型规模与数据量下的鲁棒性和效率优势
contributions.mechanism: 对比 DPO/SFT-mixing/Self-Reminder/ICD/PPL 等训练时与推理时防御，评测 AutoDAN/DeepInception/GCG/PAIR/XSTest 及组合攻击，并做训练集规模与干预强度 α 的消融
contributions.evaluation: AdvBench ASR 0.19% 超过所有基线；训练 0.01s、0 GB GPU（DPO 需 7622s/45.12GB）；1 万有害样本下仍仅 3.46% ASR（未保护 62.31%）
contributions.source_quote: It surpasses traditional methods in both performance and efficiency, offering a scalable, non-invasive solution for ensuring the safety of customized LLMs.

self_declared_provenance.quote: By employing safety probes (Li et al., 2024a), we identified the attention heads most closely associated with harmfulness, and determining a safety direction for each.

While previous works established important foundations through safety vectors (Bhardwaj et al., 2024) and various safety intervention methods (Zhao et al., 2024; Hazra et al., 2024; Yi et al., 2024), our approach uniquely operates at the attention-head level

notes: trade-off/caveat（多为正面结果）：(1) 干预强度 α 呈 U 形——α 从 0 升到 4 有害性骤降，但超过 α=4 后指标回升，过度干预会破坏模型学到的安全边界，最优 α≈4-6，需谨慎标定；(2) 通用能力有轻微退化（响应率 99.4%→98.1%，AddSub 86.33%→85.57%）；(3) 依赖'安全激活方向在微调前后相似'的假设，且需访问/修改注意力头激活。总体为强正面结果、少量效用代价。
